visualReview.method: render_final.mjs imports the final PPTX and exports PNGs; read_image was used to inspect each slide and the 2x2 montage
findings: All four slides use cream background (#F6F4EF), navy text (#0B1832), and teal accents (#14B8A6).
Cover slide title is 64px bold; content slides use 44px bold titles. Body lines are 30px navy.
Teal accent strip sits to the left of each title without overlapping any character.
Teal horizontal rule below the title spans the slide and visually separates title from body.
Page index 'N / 4' is right-aligned bottom corner on every slide.
Body bullets are separated by single blank lines; no overflow, no clipping, no truncation.
Original text and page order are preserved exactly across all four slides.

notes: Final PPTX stores PingFang SC as the latin/ea/cs typeface for every text run; if the rendering host lacks the font, the local font fallback is used (the file itself stays editable and the typefaces are preserved).
First-party Artifact Tool import was re-run as part of finalization and reported 4 slides with the expected SHA-256.
Source file input/source.pptx was not modified (sha256 verified at receipt time).

visualReviewEvidence.method: Original parent independently viewed all four final slide PNGs
visualReviewEvidence.conclusion: The four-slide demonstration retains the original content and page order, with a consistent cream, navy and teal presentation style.

handoffVerification.businessConclusion: Accepted after source integrity, editable contents, per-slide visual inspection and byte-identical HTTP downloads passed.

Now finalize a summary:

**完成情况**：

- 读入合同、Runtime 与 pptx / presentations 两套技能，按合同执行 attempt-3 独立任务
- 用 artifact-tool 真正导入源稿 `source.pptx`，保留原始 `source-title` 与 `source-body` 文本形状，仅就地重排版式、配色、字号与字体，不增删文字或页序
- 应用合同设计：背景 `#F6F4EF`，文字 `#0B1832`，teal `#14B8A6` 强调条；PingFang SC；封面标题 64px，内页标题 44px，正文 30px
- 每页新增三处原生可编辑对象：左侧 teal 短竖条、标题下方 teal 横向分隔、右下角 `N / 4` 页码
- 在不破坏 OOXML `CT_TextCharacterProperties` 顺序的前提下，向每处 `rPr/defRPr/endParaRPr` 注入 `latin/ea/cs typeface="PingFang SC"`，确保 finalizer 字体策略通过
- 走 Presentations 本地 `finalizePresentation`：包结构、版式几何、字体策略、首方 artifact-tool 重新导入均通过，结果留在 `job/build/validation.json`
- 用 artifact-tool 重新打开最终 PPTX，逐页导出 PNG 至 `build/final-preview/`，read_image 实际查看 4 张图与 2×2 缩略图，确认无溢出/遮挡/断字/低对比度问题
- 复制最终可编辑 PPTX 与 4 张 PNG + 2×2 `preview.png` 到合同指定公开目录，HTTP HEAD 实测 200 OK，`beautified.pptx` 下载字节与本地 sha256 `33821054240aa8c8d095006536b9b0f54ac6f5fc19edf64df85a515c984aa6e7` 一致
